prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent game map ground module only, not a finished character scene.
Generate one brand-new isolated garden porch platform for the Lesson 1–2 polite-handbag-return vignette. Input image 1 is the approved environment style reference only; input image 2 is a character identity, palette, and eventual overlay footprint reference only. DO NOT render any of those characters or any other person. The original characters will be composited above this separate ground asset in the app.
Canvas requested: 1536 by 1024 pixels, landscape 3:2. Real alpha transparent background. The whole detached rounded island must be visible with at least 8 percent transparent margin on all sides. Never render a white rectangle or fake checkerboard.
Match the reference environment: polished whimsical children's illustrated game world, rounded softly modeled forms, warm creamy stone paving and coral peach masonry, teal and fresh green vegetation, occasional tiny ivory and yellow flowers, soft warm light from upper left, subtle painterly texture and clean legible silhouette. Gently elevated three-quarter camera, not steep top-down.
Subject: a low broad garden porch island with substantial rounded coral-colored masonry sides and cream stone edge. A small simple pale coral garden entrance arch and sparse trimmed plants may sit at the distant rear edge; a few flowers on the extreme side edges only. The central walking/standing surface is mostly smooth cream paving with a restrained small grass patch towards the back. The island should feel like a charming piece of the approved seaside town. No water plane.
CRITICAL PLACEMENT: normalized coordinates use the full canvas. The flat unobstructed standing surface spans x=0.18..0.82 and y=0.56..0.81, with target character shoe contact at y=0.72. Keep this entire area level, empty, usable, unbroken by stairs, walls, plants, lamps, furniture or holes. The center x=0.22..0.78, y=0.08..0.72 is where an existing two-person character cutout will later be layered, so keep any backdrop low and visually secondary; optional little arch only at the very back y<0.50. All taller plants only at x<0.16 or x>0.84. Nothing in front of the character's intended feet.
The platform is a coherent piece of real illustrated terrain with softly shaded front thickness and a delicate semitransparent contact shadow; not a UI card, plaque or sticker.
No people, no human figures or silhouettes, no animals, no handbag, no stars, no medal, no lettering, no digits, no labels, no watermark, no UI. Generate only the environment ground module.
